主要内容: On December 10, 2012, the U.S. Department of the Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) announced a $132 million settlement with Standard Chartered Bank (SCB) for apparent violations of U.S. sanctions programs. This settlement is part of a combined $327 million resolution with federal and local government partners. The agreement addresses SCB’s London and Dubai offices for their involvement in practices that interfered with U.S. economic sanctions, including the Iranian Transactions Regulations (ITR), Burmese Sanctions Regulations (BSR), Sudanese Sanctions Regulations (SSR), and the now-repealed Libyan Sanctions Regulations (LSR). From 2001 to 2007, SCB’s London head office and Dubai branch engaged in payment practices that obscured sanctioned parties by altering payment messages. These actions led to millions of dollars in payments being routed through U.S. banks for sanctioned entities. SCB is required to implement policies to prevent future violations and provide OFAC with compliance reviews. The settlement also includes a $132 million forfeiture to the Department of Justice for the same conduct.

股票实体.名称: U.S. Department of the Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC)
